items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Well, people like Bud Scott and Mutt Carey, I know, told me years ago

ctx.x: Well, I heard most of them because I was a young man, around 18, 20 years old. I used to visit all churches from time to time. I'd go to a Baptist church, I'd go to a Methodist church. I'd go to a Catholic church in the morning, Mass. See, my evenings were always free to go to a church. Sometimes I'd go to, I had some friends of mine who were Baptists, and I had some friends who were Methodists, I'd attend church with them. And I'd tell you from a musical standpoint, well, I prefer the Methodist music and the…

Well, people like Bud Scott and Mutt Carey, I know, told me years ago, and other people too, they even thought some of the early dance music, the jazz bands, were influenced by the music they heard in the churches.
Well, the Baptist has the same rhythm, and the style of singing is on the blue side.
